brief:
**Goldstein Gooners (ESPN), week 4.** You're **0-3, last place**, and 8th of 10 in total points (306.5). Six of 10 teams make the playoffs, **seeded by record** (total points only break ties), over a 13-week regular season. With 10 games left, you realistically need to win about 7 of them, so every week counts.

**This week:** vs **Vivek's Handshakes** (2-1). ESPN projects **119.2 to 119.0**, a **50%** coin flip.

### Good moves already made
You've already picked up **Ollie Gordon II** (Achane is out for the season) and **Braelon Allen** (Breece Hall is week to week), plus **Kenyon Sadiq**. Those were the top waiver adds this week (NFL.com).

### Your players
- **Amon-Ra St. Brown (WR, DET) at CAR, Sunday night.** Your top projection (20.1).
- **Bucky Irving (RB, TB) and Cam Skattebo (RB, NYG):** both projected 16+.
- **Trevor Lawrence (QB, JAX) at CIN.** Cincinnati allows the 3rd-most passing yards (ESPN). Good matchup.
- **Kenyon Sadiq (TE, NYJ) is questionable:** limited in Wednesday practice with an undisclosed issue; he had offseason hernia surgery (RotoWire, ESPN). He went 7-105-1 last week.
- **Dallas Goedert (TE, PHI) is out for several weeks** with an MCL sprain (DraftKings Network). Safe to drop.
- **Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB, WSH)** should lead Washington's backfield with Rachaad White hurt, though the team is adding Austin Ekeler for passing downs (Heavy).
- **Your Patriots D/ST plays at Buffalo:** projected just 3.1. Replace it (see Waivers).

### Your opponent (Vivek's Handshakes)
- **Jayden Daniels** is questionable with a dislocated elbow (RotoWire), so they start **Kyler Murray** (19.3 proj).
- **Jaylen Waddle** was seen in a walking boot but is reportedly fine (RotoWire).
- Core: Christian McCaffrey, George Kittle, Chris Olave, Kyren Williams.

- **Sunday ~3:50pm:** St. Brown inactives (Sunday night game).

- **Jacory Croskey-Merritt:** Washington's lead back while Rachaad White is hurt.
trades:
### Where you stand
You're **0-3, last place**. Playoffs are **seeded by record** (6 of 10 teams), with total points only as a tiebreaker. With 10 games left you likely need about **7 wins**, so trade for points you can use **every week starting now**, even if it costs depth.

### Your trade capital
- **Spare RBs:** Braelon Allen, Ollie Gordon II, Jacory Croskey-Merritt.
- **Spare TEs:** Kenyon Sadiq (questionable, undisclosed issue), Tucker Kraft.
- **Spare WR:** Malik Nabers is a FLEX coin flip with George Pickens, so one of them is expendable.
- **Biggest weakness:** TE. Kraft projects 8.9; elite TEs project 16–17. That's the largest weekly gain available.

### Plan A: two trades (about +13 projected points a week)

| # | Partner | You give | You get | Why it works for you | Why they'd accept | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Ben Doverbish** (1-2) | Malik Nabers + Tucker Kraft | **Trey McBride** (TE, ARI) | Elite TE: 9 catches on 11 targets in Week 3 (NBC Sports). About +8.5 over Kraft. | Puka Nacua is questionable, so they need a WR now, and Isaiah Likely (11.8 proj) can replace McBride. Kraft refills their TE depth. | Medium–Low |
| 2 | **Jake's Scary Team** (2-1) | Ollie Gordon II + Jacory Croskey-Merritt | **Garrett Wilson** (WR, NYJ) | WR2 upgrade over Nabers. | They roster only two RBs and seven WRs. | Medium |

**Lineup after Plan A:** Lawrence; Irving, Skattebo; St. Brown, Wilson; McBride; FLEX Pickens; Bills D/ST; Mevis = **~132.5 projected** (vs 119.2 now). Braelon Allen stays as Irving's backup (glute; limited Wednesday and Thursday per RotoWire).

### Plan B: if McBride isn't available

| Partner | You give | You get | Why | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Ts pmo so I hop on cg** (2-1) | Braelon Allen + Ollie Gordon II | **Brock Bowers** (TE, LV) | Bowers is healthy and had 10-116-1 in Week 3 (NFL.com). They're down to two healthy RBs with Travis Etienne out, and have Michael Mayer as a backup TE. | Medium |
| **The Strib Club** (1-2) | Kenyon Sadiq + Jacory Croskey-Merritt | **Parker Washington** (WR, JAX) | SI ranks him WR6 this week as Jacksonville's clear WR1. Their only TE is Colston Loveland. | Low–Medium |

Plan B uses Allen and Gordon on Bowers, so Wilson is off the table. Your Irving backup becomes Croskey-Merritt unless you keep him out of the Strib Club deal.

### Don't trade
Amon-Ra St. Brown, Bucky Irving, Cam Skattebo, Trevor Lawrence. Turn down **St. Brown for Zay Flowers + Chuba Hubbard** from ranel: it projects about 2 points worse this week and hands the WR1 to a team you're chasing.

### Free moves (no trade needed)
Bills D/ST for the Patriots D/ST (+3.2), Jared Goff as a backup QB, and Juwan Johnson at TE if no TE trade happens.

*Confirm injuries before sending: Garrett Wilson was listed questionable in one report this week (RotoWire).*
